scripts.dev: docker compose up -d --build --remove-orphans && docker compose logs -f web worker
scripts.test: docker compose run --rm tools pnpm -r --if-present test
scripts.test:e2e:dev: docker compose up -d --force-recreate --wait web && docker compose --profile e2e run --rm -e E2E_WORKERS=3 e2e
scripts.db:generate: docker compose run --rm tools pnpm --filter @syntaxerror/db generate
scripts.content:validate: docker compose run --rm tools pnpm --filter @syntaxerror/content validate
